stages.journal: Eshi the warden says the walkway east of Thorn has gone under. She did not ask me to fix it. She mentioned it the way you mention weather.
I found the break. Someone cut it. The cut is clean and it is on the Thorn side.
I told Eshi. She stopped looking at me while I said it.

outcomes.journal: I laid new boards. Nobody thanked me and the way east is open.
I said whose knife it was. The hall is quieter now.
I left it under water. It is not my walkway.
